---
title: "Jack F"
---

Your exploratory data analysis of the team datasets go here.

```{r}
soccer <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2023/2023-04-04/soccer21-22.csv')
library(tidyverse)

```
```{r}
soccer %>%
  count(FTR)
```
```{r}
ggplot(soccer, aes(x = FTR, fill = FTR)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Soccer Match Results",
    x = "Match Result",
    y = "Number of Matches"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
ggplot(soccer, aes(x = FTHG)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Home Team Goals",
    x = "Home Team Goals", 
    y = "Number of Matches"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
ggplot(soccer, aes(x = HS, y = FTHG)) + 
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  labs(
    title = "Relationship Between Shots and Goals", 
    x = "Home Team Shots", 
    y = "Home Team Goals"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
